H2_calibration.quote: Items 6, 23, 41, and 44 rely on readings a court would probably reject. I'd use them sparingly.

H1_holdback.quote: Raising loopholes publicly at markup invites a further manager's amendment to close them, especially items 1, 13, 20, 21, and 24. The team may want to separate points to raise as "unworkability" objections from those better preserved quietly for post-enactment compliance planning.
